create_TouristContinuous: create a TouristContinuous model with vocab size, observations, actions, and MASC attention settings
run_TouristContinuous_forward: run the TouristContinuous forward pass on a batch to get observation and action embeddings
save_TouristContinuous: save the TouristContinuous model state and hyperparameters to a file path
load_TouristContinuous: load a TouristContinuous model from a saved checkpoint file path
create_GuideContinuous: create a GuideContinuous model with vocab size, landmarks, and MASC attention settings
